stem.text: A molecule of geraniol is shown.

stem.label: geraniol
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of geraniol: a C10 chain with two C=C double bonds and a terminal CH2OH group

stem.text: What is formed when geraniol is reacted with an excess of cold, dilute, acidified manganate(VII) ions?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a saturated chain with several OH groups, including two on tertiary carbons, and a terminal CH2OH; no C=C

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a chain with two C=O groups, two OH groups on tertiary carbons, and a terminal C(=O)OH

D.alt: Skeletal formula of an unsaturated acid with two C=C double bonds in the chain and a terminal C(=O)OH
